title.en: An Act Authorizing a Readjustment of Leave Earned By Frank W. Carpenter During His Service as Executive Secretary, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
A readjustment of the leave granted in nineteen hundred and ten to Frank W. Carpenter, for the
purpose of allowing the payment of that part of the half pay travel time voluntarily relinquished by him in that
year, is hereby authorized.

The refund of the money received by Frank W. Carpenter in commutation of accrued leave, half
salary, and transportation to the United States earned by him during his service as Executive Secretary
required under the provisions of section twenty-seven of Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and ninety-eight by
reason of his appointment as Governor of the Moro Province, is hereby expressly waived, the provisions of
said section twenty-seven of Act Numbered Sixteen hundred and ninety-eight to the contrary notwithstanding.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 28, 1914.
